description: This file defines functions and types for parsing, normalizing, and matching elevated allowlist entries in a chat application, including handling sender prefixes and token variants.

methods.name: stripSenderPrefix
methods.description: Removes sender prefix from a string if present.

methods.name: parseExplicitElevatedAllowEntry
methods.description: Parses an allowlist entry string into a field and value if valid.

methods.name: addFormattedTokens
methods.description: Formats and adds tokens to a set based on a formatter function.

methods.name: matchesFormattedTokens
methods.description: Checks if a value matches any token in a set after formatting.

methods.name: buildMutableTokens
methods.description: Builds a set of tokens from a string, including slug variants.

methods.name: matchesMutableTokens
methods.description: Checks if a string matches any token in a set, including slug variants.
